commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Robert Schroder has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Neat passing move from Eintracht Frankfurt in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The game has come to an end for Hugo Ekitike. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nacho (Eintracht Frankfurt).
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) coming on for Rocco Reitz.
88' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Robin Hack.
87' It looks like Tony Jantschke (B. Monchengladbach) saw red with that tackle. Robert Schroder won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
86' A rebound falls at the feet of Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach), who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies well wide of the right post.
85' We are about to witness a substitution. Tony Jantschke (B. Monchengladbach) is replacing Nico Elvedi.
84' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough challenge and Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul.

78' The attendance is 54042.

77' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) who loops his header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
76' Here is a change. Fares Chaibi is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt).
76' The referee signals a substitution. Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) is brought on as a substitute for Ellyes Skhiri.
75' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
74' Robert Schroder blows his whistle and it's Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

71' Fares Chaibi floats the corner into the six-yard box, but the ball spins off the head of Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) and falls to safety well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
70' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
70' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Good work from Eintracht Frankfurt as they win a corner.
69' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
68' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
67' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Robert Schroder no option but to blow his whistle.
64' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Great teamplay by Eintracht Frankfurt as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Junior Dina Ebimbe departs the field of play to be replaced by Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt).
61' B. Monchengladbach can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

60' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Robert Schroder with no other option than to blow for a foul.
59' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post.
58' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Franck Honorat walks off the pitch to be replaced by Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach).
57' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Alassane Plea and he is replaced by Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach).
55' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
50' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
50' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box. Now Eintracht Frankfurt have a corner.
49' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Hugo Ekitike.
48' Dangerous play by Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt). Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul.

41' There's an opportunity for Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

40' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
38' B. Monchengladbach seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
35' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Hugo Ekitike tees up Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Jonas Omlin.

33' The opposition back off Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp denies him with the save.
32' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
29' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
27' The game is interrupted. One of the players from B. Monchengladbach is cautioned for aggressive play.
25' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) was quite harsh and Robert Schroder didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' 2:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 2:0.
20' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Robert Schroder signals.

19' A brilliant individual effort! Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.

17' The corner is sent into the box by Fares Chaibi, but Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) flashes the ball a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
17' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

16' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
15' The resulting corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
15' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. They send men into the box.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Eintracht Frankfurt.

13' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Eintracht Frankfurt are going to take it.
13' Eintracht Frankfurt enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
11' A player from Eintracht Frankfurt commits a rough challenge. Robert Schroder blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.

9' 1 - 0 Goal! Joe Scally plays in Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 1:0.
8' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
6' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
4' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) causes Kevin Trapp little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
4' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) works the corner short.

3' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
